maestro-brief-1.caption: The morning brief arrives in Google Chat, and it starts with good news.
maestro-brief-1.alt: Google Chat with the Maestro app open. A morning message says "Good Morning! Kudos!", reports schedule attainment of 99% against a 98% target, and lists three team members with Kudos buttons.

maestro-framework-1.caption: The first framework: a proactive brief, and on-demand answers in three blocks, explored in dark and light.
maestro-framework-1.alt: Early framework board: a dark proactive card, a sketch board that starts with "Start here: Proactive" and on-demand blocks for data, insights and coaching, and answer cards explored in dark and light.

maestro-answer-1.caption: An on-demand answer repeats the question, then shows the agents behind the number.
maestro-answer-1.alt: Google Chat: a team lead asks "Which team members had a Schedule Attainment of less than 98%?" Maestro repeats the question, date range, campaign and result, then lists three agents, each with a Coaching Alert button.

maestro-brief-full-1.caption: The full morning brief: four KPIs, the bottom 3 for each, the likely causes, resources and actions.
maestro-brief-full-1.alt: The full morning brief: schedule attainment, adherence, AHT and CSAT in turn. Each section has a short table, most with Kudos or Coaching Alert buttons, then insights for each agent, links to policies and dashboards, and recommended training.

maestro-insights-before-1.caption: Before: the first insight lines
maestro-insights-before-1.alt: Early insight lines under "Identified Cause": extended conversation duration, increased follow-up tasks, and prolonged handling time, one for each agent.

maestro-insights-after-1.caption: After: the shipped insight lines
maestro-insights-after-1.alt: Final insight lines: one agent had higher talk time by 20 seconds, one had higher hold time by 30 seconds, and one had higher after-call work by 15 seconds, each over the last 2 weeks.

maestro-tables-1.caption: Tables open with three rows. Show more opens the full list, and Show less closes it.
maestro-tables-1.alt: The same table in two states: three rows with a Show more button, and eight rows with a Show less button. Each row has a Kudos button.

maestro-chart-1.caption: An early answer with a simple line chart, and the accuracy line at the top.
maestro-chart-1.alt: An early answer card: the question and result, a table of three team leads' AHT over three weeks, a simple line chart of the same data, three suggested courses with Assign buttons, and Continue and Open PowerBI buttons.

maestro-alerts-1.caption: An NCNS alert with one-tap replies, and the alert frequency settings. SANS was a name the team tried for the chatbot.
maestro-alerts-1.alt: Left: an NCNS alert saying a direct report, Jordan Ellis, is tagged for the shift, with four one-tap replies and a Notification Configuration chip. Right: frequency options for SANS notifications, and a confirmation that the frequency changed to 1 hour before the shift ends.

maestro-error-1.caption: When Maestro cannot answer, it says why, next to the question that was asked.
maestro-error-1.alt: Google Chat with a Maestro error card: an "Error!" label, the question about GPR attainment, and a red line saying the employee Jordan Ellis is not a direct report of supervisor Sam Taylor.

maestro-watch-1.caption: After an answer, Maestro offers to keep an eye on the number.
maestro-watch-1.alt: Google Chat: a team lead asks for the team's running adherence. Maestro answers with the result, three paragraphs of insights, links to the adherence policy and dashboard, then asks "Want me to keep an eye on this?" with three options.

maestro-watch-options-1.caption: Options A and B had two choices. Option C splits the hourly choice in two, so each choice says exactly what happens.
maestro-watch-options-1.alt: Three versions of the "Want me to keep an eye on this?" card, labelled A, B and C. A and B offer two options. C offers three: ping me as soon as it changes, ping me hourly on significant changes, and send me an hourly summary.

maestro-analyse-1.caption: A policy answer in the chat, and a spreadsheet attached for analysis.
maestro-analyse-1.alt: Google Chat: Maestro summarises the leave policy for employees in India, and the team lead attaches a spreadsheet with the message "Analyse this document, who are my top performers?"
